# Analyze Model Registry Test Failures

Analyze test failures for the Model Registry component from Jenkins builds.

**Generated by**: `/create-component-skill` on 2026-07-02  
**Component**: model-registry  
**Framework**: pytest  
**Repository**: https://github.com/opendatahub-io/model-registry

---

## Usage

```bash
/analyze-failures
/analyze-failures --build 28
/analyze-failures --build 28 --verbose
```

---

## Implementation

Uses platform's `analyze_component.py`:

```bash
python3 scripts/analyze_component.py model-registry pytest --build 28
```

**Output**: `reports/by-component/model-registry/build-{num}-rhoai.html`

Opens in browser with:
- Rich dark-themed interface
- Interactive summary cards  
- Test suite breakdown
- Detailed failures (if any)
- Cluster health status
